description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand interface, providing functionality related to retrieving feature properties in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines a class that encapsulates the command data, including a feature ID, and provides methods to create instances and set headers.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand interface, representing a live command to retrieve feature properties associated with a specific feature ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl from a general Command object, casting it to RetrieveFeatureProperties.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders set, based on the original command data.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for constructing the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including its class name and super class info.
